people.role: Lieutenant of the Bobtail robbers; led the 1190 raid on the Đồng Sơn road
people.backstory: A stonecutter's son of Thạch Công Thôn who ran to the ridge after he killed a tax clerk; he led the 1190 raid under the mist (N-vu_an-04) and wants the band to stop feeding the hill villages and start taking from them.

ties.note: his chief; too soft, he thinks
found the mist-holder by his voice in 1190

people.role: The youngest robber on the Bobtail ridge, who wants out
people.backstory: A tea-picker's sixth child, given to the camp in a hungry winter, he held the horses in the 1190 raid at twelve; he leaves a bowl of rice at Bối Trường Đình's (boi_truong_dinh) milestone every month and wonders whether the mist would take a robber twice.

ties.note: held the horses the night the boy's caravan died

build.note: A boy with an axe he has never swung at a man.

people.gloss: Bobtail, named for the ridge he held
people.cause: killed by a Thúy Vi road patrol on the Thạch Công road (N-loose_north-02)
people.role: Old chief of the Bobtail robbers, who raised Khấu Thiên Tứ and Triều Ngũ Lang
people.backstory: He held the ridge for a century and raised two nobodies' sons in the camp, hafting an axe in lynx bone for each; one went into the mist in 1081 (N-vu_an-02), and the other buried him in 1139.

people.role: Hemp smuggler of Đào Sa Thị; brings Lạc Hà's Tang Ma hemp over the border for Lãng Đào's ropes
people.backstory: Since the Ferry War closed the border he has brought Tang Ma Thành's hemp (A201) across by night for Sài Kết Lãm (sai_ket_lam); Mao Đinh Lang (mao_dinh_lang), a gold-washer's orphan who fished nails from the river in 1173 (A080), runs it across the toll line, and Đinh takes it from the landing to the ropewalk.

ties.note: his one buyer, who tells his head the hemp comes from elsewhere
the Lạc Hà-side runner; they have never crossed the same bank
wants the war fought again, which would end the trade

tree.intent: Water evasion: a man who is never on the boat when it is searched.

people.role: Gold-washer of Đào Sa who keeps her husband's smuggling ledger in her pan
people.backstory: She has washed the river sand a thousand times for its gold (A076) since girlhood and keeps Đinh Vạn Tác's (dinh_van_tac) ledger in the false bottom of her pan; Thường Thiên Đào (thuong_thien_dao), who keeps the washers' tally, has started counting her pan twice.

people.role: Fence for Ice beast cores on the frost coast; ships them south inside the ice-fish run
people.backstory: He buys Ice beast cores from coast hunters and from Phàn Cổ Đăng's (phan_co_dang) crew, packs them in the bellies of ice-fish, and ships them past the escort to Mộc Lan for a Thiên Bảo Trai buyer; Sử Phá Băng (su_pha_bang) has been hunting him for two winters.

ties.note: the escort captain looking for him

people.cause: burned by the ward of Băng Hỏa Môn's sealed fire hall (N-loose_north-01)
people.role: Phàn Cổ Đăng's Dao partner; died forcing the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn
people.backstory: A seal-cutter's boy of Mộc Lan who dug the frost coast beside Phàn Cổ Đăng (phan_co_dang) for sixty years; in 1171 he forced the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn (V083) with a borrowed fire talisman, and its ward burned him where he stood.

people.role: Ice-cutter of the ruin crew; failed the Pavilion's Frost Test three times and took the road
people.backstory: He sat on the frozen mere of Hàn Giao Chử three solstice nights beside Thang Phục Tuyết (thang_phuc_tuyet) and walked back off the ice with him on the third morning; Thang went south, and Khổng went to cut the Pavilion's dead halls out of the ice, still sitting the Clear Frost primer every night.

ties.note: walked back across the lake together
the outer gate's master, who remembers him
he walks south to Hòe Âm every autumn
carries him out when the air goes bad

build.note: An ice axe and the Pavilion's primer, kept.

people.role: A Phù Kiều gambler of the Hàn Tân quay whose debts Tùng Đào bought
people.backstory: Luyện Tố Y's (luyen_to_y) younger brother has lost at Cát Châu Nương's (cat_chau_nuong) dice house for forty years; in 1192 she bought his debts on Tùng Đào's silver, and the price is the Mist-Lock Lantern's key, which his sister holds each spring while her head relays the gate.

build.note: A lucky ring that is not.

people.role: Ferry girl of the Cold Ford; the night ferryman's apprentice
people.backstory: Found as a baby in the reeds of drowned Lô Khẩu Trấn (V025), she has poled Nhâm Độ Hàn's (nham_do_han) second boat since she was twelve and is starting to remember the faces he tells her to forget.

build.note: A small anchor and a long pole.

people.gloss: Poria, the fungus on old pine roots
people.role: Ginseng digger of Bạch Viên Lĩnh, the white apes' ridge
people.backstory: She digs ginseng on the apes' ridge above dead Thải Sâm Trấn, where the diggers of 979 went too high (V040), sells it at Bì Tứ Nương's (bi_tu_nuong) table, and hates the Thúy Vi martens that find in a season what she finds in ten.

ties.note: the marten-keeper whose beasts undercut her

people.role: Keeper of the Loose Table, the wineshop under the pines where Tùng Hạ's loose cultivators drink
people.backstory: A wine-maker's daughter who came down to the market in 1150 and set one long table under a pine; every loose cultivator of the pine sea has drunk at it, and the foundation pills in the jar behind her counter come with no promise, as Lâm Dã Hạc (lam_da_hac) knows.

ties.note: drank at her table thirty years; now drinks on the hill

people.role: The oasis girl with more Water than the desert has bred; her mother will not let her sit the Frost Test
people.backstory: Her father Hà Khổ Hàn (ha_kho_han), who failed the test three times, named her for the ice he never found and taught her the Pavilion's outer primer before he died; she set out from Ngư Đàm with the Desert Pavilion's spring caravan to sit the solstice night uninvited on the frozen mere at Hàn Giao Chử, nine months on the road, beside Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam), whatever her mother says.

ties.note: the village's last hope on the ice, before her
the elder who asks for her each spring

tree.intent: Water linh lực and the hope of Ice.

people.cause: buried in a sandstorm at Phong Sa Nhãn guarding a salt caravan (N-loose_north-03)
people.role: Frost Test failure turned caravan guard; Mông Thủy Hương's husband
people.backstory: A salt-boiler's son of Chử Diêm Thôn sent to the Frost Test by the Desert Pavilion, he felt nothing three winters running, chose the road over a vassal, and guarded salt caravans with Hô Diên Liệt (ho_dien_liet) until the storm of 1194.

people.role: A Dạ Quang outer rider who left when the young blades took up the cups again; casts camel bells at Đà Linh Trấn
people.backstory: He rode in Dạ Quang's outer gate until 1194, when Hạng Lưu Hỏa (hang_luu_hoa) drank from the night-glow cups again (A126); his grandmother's brother had been left in the sand with one on his chest, so he left the opposite way to Tất Dạ Lang (tat_da_lang) and casts camel bells.

ties.note: outer riders together; she still writes
rides with him when a cup is found

build.note: Dạ Quang's outer primer and a sabre (on the phi_kiem base until a sabre base exists); he casts camel bells for his living.

people.role: Storyteller of Trường Vân's caravan inns; a weak five-element root no gate would take
people.backstory: Tested in 1135 by the Desert Pavilion, Trấn Sa's guard families and Dạ Quang's riders, he holds a little of every element and enough of none, so he tells the Desert Road War (C142) at the caravan inns for his supper and can light any talisman a customer hands him.

ties.note: tells his stories better than he does
tested him in 1135 and still buys his supper

tree.intent: A little of everything: talisman and ward nodes.

build.note: A root of five and a pocket of talismans.

people.role: The last sable trapper of Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm
people.backstory: The sables were trapped out of the hills long ago (V005), and he still runs his lines from Hàn Yên Thôn; in 1189 he helped Quản Tuyết Tung (quan_tuyet_tung) dig the wolf-king's cub out of Quần Lang Lâm for a third of the price, and he drinks every winter the wolves howl.

people.role: Guide of Phản Cảnh Lâm, who walks lost travellers out by the evening light
people.backstory: In 1192 he followed the white moon-fox's tracks off the lake (A016) into Phản Cảnh Lâm, where footprints go in and not out (A012), and came out three days later with frost in his hair; hunters and Quản Tuyết Tung's (quan_tuyet_tung) buyers pay him to bring them out by the lingering dusk (A008).

build.note: A guide's lantern he never lights.

people.role: Moonstone miner with a Thunder root in an Ice sect's mountains
people.backstory: Born in the moonstone shafts where the vein's thunder runs through the rock, he was lashed at nine and woke with Thunder in him; the Pavilion's vein warden Kha Tĩnh Ba (kha_tinh_ba), lashed by the same vein, told him what he was and that no sect north of the desert teaches it.

build.note: A miner's axe and a Thunder primer bought off a southern pedlar.

people.role: Snow-lotus gatherer above Hòe Âm
people.backstory: She climbs the ice above the hermitage gate for snow lotus each summer, with the grey sister Hướng Thiết Lan's (huong_thiet_lan) leave on the lower paths, and sells it to the Pavilion's guest alchemist Viên Chước (vien_chuoc), who still owes her for last year.

ties.note: lets her pass the gate paths
owes her for last year's lotus

people.role: Snow-jade miner with a Light root; left the Pivot's outer gate after failing its Level Beam by five
people.backstory: A snow-jade miner's daughter, she sat three years in the Pivot's outer gate and failed the Level Beam each spring with Metal forty, five short, under Chử Bình Quân's (chu_binh_quan) steady hand; she left in 1198, because no one there could teach the light that comes off the jade into her at dawn.

ties.note: taught her to hold the weights; begged her to stay

tree.intent: Light's first nodes, felt for alone.

build.note: A snow-jade pendant she cut herself.

people.role: Charcoal-burner's daughter with a Darkness root; a woman in red has offered to teach her
people.backstory: Born in the ash village beside the dark gorge of Tuyến Thiên Hạp, she sees better in kiln smoke than in daylight; at Lam Yên Thị in 1199 a woman in a red robe bought her charcoal, looked at her a long time, and said she would come back with a book.

ties.note: the woman in red; she does not know her name

tree.intent: Darkness, found by herself in the smoke.
